verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only web-UI workflows for the Guichet unique: filing formalities, uploading documents, dashboards, payment, and anonymisation done 'directement depuis le site'. Nothing documents an API for any of these, let alone parity with the UI. The keyless recherche-entreprises probe concerns a separate read-only state company-search API, not Guichet unique filing, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
